description: Cities with currency, timezone, radius and tier. tier is driver presence, not whether booking works: "live" = drivers based there were online in the last 24 h; "scheduled" = bookable, approved drivers are based there (book ahead, we match one); "waitlist" = not bookable yet. Never call a scheduled city unavailable or not live; say it is bookable ahead. Free.
